references.text: Pharaoh's conversation with Abram after discovering that Sarai was his wife resembles Abimelech's conversation with Abraham.
Abimelech's conversation with Isaac regarding Rebekah mirrors his earlier conversation with Abraham about Sarah.

Moses accuses Aaron with almost identical wording: 'What has this people done to you, that you have brought such great sin (חֲטָאָה גְדֹלָה) upon them?' – the same expression Abimelech uses against Abraham.
Joseph rejects Potiphar's wife's advances by referring to a 'great sin against God' – the same expression (חֲטָאָה גְדֹלָה) that Abimelech uses regarding Abraham's deception.
The direct continuation of Abimelech's conversation with Abraham, where he asks what Abraham's intention was with his deception.
Repetition of Abimelech's confrontation with Abraham (Gen 20) and Isaac (Gen 26) over a hidden marriage and the danger of sin.
Identical situation: Pharaoh (Gen 12) and Abimelech (Gen 20) confront Abraham about a hidden marriage.
